instruction: Tidy up the desk: toy blocks go in the purple toy box, mugs go on the cyan tray and the pen stands upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Grasp red_block and place it into purple_box
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_block")
# Pick best candidate (prefer one that fits open fingers, sorted by score)
valid_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]
best_candidate = max(valid_candidates, key=lambda c: c["score"])

res = grasp(best_candidate)
if res["holding_something"]:
    obs = observe()
    box = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]
    target_x, target_y = box["center"][0], box["center"][1]
    
    # Carry above purple_box (height ensures clearing the box's rim)
    carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(0.12)
    check("red_block", "purple_box")

# Grasp yellow_pen, reorient it upright, and insert it into magenta_holder
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Filter candidates that fit the gripper and sort by score
valid_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c["fits_open_fingers"]]
valid_candidates.sort(key=lambda c: c.get("score", 0), reverse=True)
candidate = valid_candidates[0]

res = grasp(candidate)
if res["holding_something"]:
    obs = observe()
    holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
    table_z = obs["table_z"]
    rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)
    hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]

    # Lift above the holder
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.15)

    # Orient pen vertically: since yellow_pen was grasped across its width while horizontal,
    # the pen lies along the 'side' vector of the gripper (side = approach x finger_axis).
    # To point the pen downwards (along -Z), we orient the gripper approach horizontally
    # so that side points down [0, 0, -1].
    # Approach horizontally along +X: approach = [1, 0, 0], finger_axis = [0, 1, 0] -> side = [0, 0, -1]
    move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.12, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="line")

    # Lower into holder
    move_by(dz=-0.08)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.12)
    go_home()
    check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
